createDirectAssignmentRulesRequestBody.description: Request body for creating a direct assignment rule

name.description: Name of the direct assignment rule

description.description: Description of the direct assignment rule

status.description: Status of the rule. Possible values: ACTIVE, INACTIVE

executeOptions.description: Execution options configured for the rule. Possible values: CREATE, EDIT. Both values can be configured together

fieldName.description: Display name of the field used in the condition. Use field display names (not API names). Common examples: Status, Priority, Channel, Subject, Department, Contact Name, Product Name, Due Date. Refer to the getCriteriaFields API to get valid field names for a department.

value.description: Value(s) for the field condition. The values depend on the field type. For picklist fields like Status use the display value (e.g., 'Open', 'Closed'). For ID-based fields like Department or Product use the entity ID. Not required when condition is 'is empty' or 'is not empty'.

condition.description: Condition operator for the field. Possible values: is, is not, contains, not contains, starts with, ends with, is empty, is not empty, is open, is on hold, is closed, is escalated, is overdue. The available conditions depend on the field type.

fieldModule.description: Module to which the field belongs. Possible values: tickets, contacts, accounts, products.

fieldConditions.description: Field conditions configured for the target criteria

pattern.description: Logical expression that references fieldConditions by their 1-based index. Use AND/OR operators to combine multiple conditions. Examples: '(1)' for a single condition, '(1 AND 2)' for two conditions with AND, '(1 OR 2)' for OR, '((1 AND 2) OR 3)' for nested logic.

fromDepartmentId.description: Unique ID of the source department of the target. Pass 0 to apply the rule to tickets from any department.

toDepartmentId.description: Unique ID of the target department

agentId.description: Unique ID of the agent assigned in the target. The agent must belong to the toDepartmentId. If both agentId and teamId are provided, the agent must belong to the specified team. If neither is provided, the rule only moves the ticket to the target department without assigning.

teamId.description: Unique ID of the team assigned in the target. Requires Team Assignment to be enabled for the toDepartmentId. Can be provided along with agentId if the agent belongs to the team.

targets.description: List of targets configured for this rule
